User story: As a data analyst, I want to extract pricing information from PDFs, so that I can compare vendor offerings in a structured format.
As a data analyst, I want to translate extracted data into a standardized format for LLM use, so that I can analyze vendor data accurately.
As a data analyst, I want to store vendor data in a MongoDB database, so that I can easily retrieve and compare data from various vendors.
As a procurement manager, I want to enable real-time analysis of vendor data through a user-friendly interface, so that I can make informed decisions about supplier selection and pricing.
As a procurement manager, I want to compare pricing information from various suppliers, so that I can identify the best vendors for our needs.
As a procurement manager, I want to receive recommendations for the best suppliers based on vendor data, so that I can streamline our procurement process.
As a procurement manager, I want to calculate the total cost of procurement, so that I can optimize our costs and make better purchasing decisions.
As a recipe developer, I want to analyze ingredient costs and optimize recipes, so that I can reduce our expenses and improve product offerings.
As a procurement manager, I want to compare supplier rates for pasta, so that I can identify the best vendors for our pasta needs.
As a recipe developer, I want to calculate the cost of recipes, so that I can ensure that our products are competitively priced and profitable.
As a data analyst, I want to develop APIs for data uploads, so that we can easily integrate vendor data into our system.
As a procurement manager, I want to enable enhanced analysis of vendor data through a user-friendly interface, so that I can make more informed decisions about supplier selection and pricing.
